impl.factionSystem: FACTION SYSTEM (Engine-Correct Pattern). Definition Location: OpenRA.Game/Traits/World/Faction.cs. Factions attach to World actor via Faction@{InternalName} traits. In mods/cnc/rules/world.yaml (canonical example): Faction@gdi with Name faction-gdi.name (fluent ref), InternalName gdi, Description faction-gdi.description, Side GDI, Selectable true. To add THEATER's 12 factions, create mods/ra/rules/theater-factions.yaml with entries for federation, union, continental, levant, anatolian, peninsula, rhine, gallic, isles, subcontinent, eastern, persian. Each has InternalName (used for prerequisite checks) and Name/Description fluent refs. Add to mod.yaml Rules section. Lobby automatically lists all Faction@* traits; players pick per-player. Map YAML sets LockFaction: true to enforce. No C# changes needed for faction definition itself.
impl.unitFactionLocking: UNIT FACTION-LOCKING (Prerequisites Pattern). Mechanism: Buildable.Prerequisites uses tilde-prefixed faction tags. Core flow: (1) Building/HQ provides prerequisite via ProvidesPrerequisite@faction with Prerequisite: federation.hq. (2) Unit/building has Buildable Prerequisites: federation.hq meaning only players with that prereq can build it. Prerequisites can use ~ for negation (e.g., ~union.tech) to exclude factions. Pattern in YAML: UNIT: Inherits RA_UNIT, Buildable Prerequisites: federation.signature OR Prerequisites: ~union.tech, either works. For faction-specific versions: reskin same RA unit body with different Tooltip.Name fluent ref and RenderSprites.Image override. Example: MNLY (Mammoth) becomes MNLY_FED (Federation version), inherits MNLY, adds RenderSprites FactionImages federation: mnly_fed. Files: OpenRA.Mods.Common/Traits/Conditions/GrantConditionOnPrerequisite.cs (grants conditions when prereqs available), OpenRA.Mods.Common/Traits/Player/TechTree.cs (checks prerequisites), OpenRA.Mods.Common/Traits/Buildable.cs (enforces checks). No mod-data change to core; pure YAML trait configuration.
impl.modernReskinApproach: MODERN-RESKIN APPROACH (Display Name + Cameo + Image Override, No New Art). Three layers: (1) DISPLAY NAME via Tooltip trait fluent reference. Existing Mammoth Tank (actor MNLY, tooltip Name actor-mtnk.name) becomes Federation Mammoth via new name actor-fed-mammoth.name in fluent, then new unit variant FED_MNLY with Tooltip Name: actor-fed-mammoth.name. (2) CAMEO ICON via RenderSprites Image override. RA/cnc use .shp sprite sheets indexed-color. THEATER cameos (UI sidebar icons) use GPT-generated PNG + chroma-key + autocrop, stored at mods/ra/uibits/cameos/. RenderSprites already supports FactionImages dict: FactionImages federation: unit_aril means load federation-specific cameo. Engine loads via PngSheetLoader.cs (already integrated). Scripts: design/art/generate_image.py (gpt-image-2 generation), design/art/postprocess_cameo.py (chroma-key + indexed-palette conversion). (3) IN-WORLD SPRITE unchanged (Phase 1). Existing RA body (Mammoth silhouette) stays; identity is fluent name + cameo. Later (Phase 3+): push through Blender 3D-turntable for bespoke 32-facing, via RenderVoxels.cs (already in engine, used by TS mod). Path: RenderVoxels accepts 3D model or .vxl/.hva, renders orthographic turntable, downscales to indexed PNG with remap mask (zero rotational inconsistency). Fallback: keep RA originals; cameo + name = 80% identity. Files: mods/ra/uibits/cameos/*.png (GPT output), mods/ra/sequences/theater-cameos.yaml (sprite/cameo frame defs), mods/ra/rules/theater-units.yaml (RenderSprites + FactionImages config).
impl.researchAndEras: RESEARCH/ERAS (Prerequisites + ProvidesPrerequisite + Conditions). Three-layer architecture: (1) ERAS as gated tech tiers. Present Day -> Networked -> Autonomous -> Near-Future. Each era is a ProvidesPrerequisite on a dedicated building (era-one.hq, era-two.hq, etc.). Building appears in production queue only after previous era unlocked. Prerequisites chain: Building Building1 Buildable Prerequisites: anypower (standard RA), after build Building1 ProvidesPrerequisite era.one -> all era.one.* units become buildable. (2) DOCTRINE (irreversible fork) via LobbyPrerequisiteCheckbox (file OpenRA.Mods.Common/Traits/Player/LobbyPrerequisiteCheckbox.cs). Checkbox appears in lobby, grants one of four prerequisites: doctrine.economy, doctrine.military, doctrine.defense, doctrine.diplomacy. Each faction's signature unit/building requires its doctrine. (3) UPGRADES (mutually exclusive tree). GrantConditionOnPrerequisite (trait file Conditions/GrantConditionOnPrerequisite.cs) binds prerequisites to conditions; conditions gate unit behavior (damage, speed). Example: Drone swarm beats armor -> prerequisite drone.tech + condition high-speed on swarm units. Implementation: (a) Create building EraCenter building provides era.one, era.two, etc. on capture/develop. (b) Add doctrine checkboxes to World player trait. (c) Create tech units (e.g., ERLU = era-unlock) that appear conditionally, granted ONCE per match, can't be rebuilt. (d) Gate units/buildings via Prerequisites: era.two, doctrine.military. No ResearchQueue C# needed; pure TechTree + Prerequisites. Files: mods/ra/rules/theater-research.yaml (building + checkbox defs), OpenRA.Mods.Common/Traits/Player/TechTree.cs (prerequisite eval), OpenRA.Mods.Common/Traits/Buildable.cs (builds only if prereqs met).
impl.economyAndTerritory: ECONOMY/TERRITORY (Hybrid: Ore + Territory Structures, Already Verified). Phase 0b-Tested Hybrid: Keep ore/harvester loop at 100% (RA baseline). Territory structures are pure bonus, not replacement. (1) CASH PRINTER (Capturable Oil Derrick). Actor CTRLCASH in theater.yaml: Inherits OILB, CashTrickler@base Amount: 12 (undeveloped), CashTrickler@dev Amount: 24 (after develop), DevelopsWhileHeld trait (in mods/ra/rules/theater.yaml, confirmed built; file path /Users/ashishnaik/Projects/openra/mods/ra/rules/theater.yaml). Develop cost 1200 ticks (~30s at default speed). (2) CAPABILITY NODES (non-economic). FCOM (Forward Command) gives BuildableArea expansion. CTRLLAB (Tech Lab) provides tech unlock (theater.techlab prerequisite). HOSP (Hospital) heals infantry. (3) NO AMPLIFIER YET (deferred: Phase 0b notes say RefineryConcession needs C# owner-change fix to work as mod-data). (4) TERRITORY -> SUPPLY LINES (cuttable convoys). Reskin harvester loop: harvesters still drive ore to refinery, but add \"convoy\" actor types that transfer rare-earths/uranium/lithium from deposit -> Stockpile building. If cut, that resource trickles stop (strategic chokepoint without touching base). Implementation: existing Harvester trait has path; spawn invisible \"convoy\" dummy actors on harvester's path to destination, destroy one = damage the supply line. Deterministic: integer-only math. Files: mods/ra/rules/theater.yaml (territory structure defs, DevelopsWhileHeld.cs already on-disk), mods/ra/scripts/theater-setup.lua (auto-place nodes on match start, verified deterministic Lua), OpenRA.Mods.Common/Traits/DevelopsWhileHeld.cs (pre-built, in repo, handles develop mechanic).

impl.devModeUnlockAll: DEV MODE UNLOCK-ALL (DeveloperMode.AllTech + LobbyPrerequisiteCheckbox for Faction Bypass). Mechanism: (1) DeveloperMode trait (file /Users/ashishnaik/Projects/openra/OpenRA.Mods.Common/Traits/Player/DeveloperMode.cs) has AllTech flag toggled by chat command /enable-tech or lobby checkbox. When AllTech=true, TechTree.HasPrerequisites always returns true (verified in code: DeveloperMode.AllTech checked in production queue logic). (2) For FACTION-LOCKED units (prerequisite: federation.hq), AllTech alone doesn't help; still need federation.hq prerequisite to build. SOLUTION: Add LobbyPrerequisiteCheckbox to World player trait, one per faction. Checkboxes grant all-faction prerequisites at game start (lobby option, toggleable). Example in World: LobbyPrerequisiteCheckbox@unlock_all_factions with ID devunlock, Label devunlock.label, Prerequisites federation.hq, union.hq, continental.hq, ... (all 12 blocs). When checked, all faction prerequisites are provided. Checked by default if DeveloperMode enabled. Implementation in theater-factions.yaml: add to Player trait a new LobbyPrerequisiteCheckbox with all 12+ faction prereqs; make it visible only in dev mode or always-on for skirmish. Files: mods/ra/rules/player.yaml (add LobbyPrerequisiteCheckbox trait to Player), OpenRA.Mods.Common/Traits/Player/LobbyPrerequisiteCheckbox.cs (already built, grants prereqs if lobby option enabled), OpenRA.Mods.Common/Traits/Player/DeveloperMode.cs (allTech toggles tech access). impl.worldMap: WORLD MAP (Procedural Generation + Hand Spawn Points). THEATER does NOT need bespoke map generator code; existing ClassicMapGenerator.cs (C# in engine, read-only, in mods/ra/rules/map-generators.yaml) already parametrizes everything. (1) PROCEDURAL PATH: Set ClassicMapGenerator parameters for Continents terrain type (TerrainFeatureSize 102400 for big landmasses). Players selects generator, map gen produces 192x192 or 256x256 (standard RA sizes, scalable in ClassicMapGenerator config). Spawn points auto-placed by engine MapStartingLocations trait. To create a real-world-shaped world map: hand-author map.yaml binary (.map bin file) with custom terrain tiles (land/water pattern matching real continents). Map.yaml format verified at mods/ra/maps/allies-06b/map.yaml; uses TileData (binary compressed terrain) + Actors (spawn points, creeps, landmarks). (2) HAND-AUTHORED PATH (Higher Effort, Full Control): Use OpenRA map editor (Mod>Editor, File>New) to paint terrain (landmasses), place spawn points per player. Editor saves .yaml (map metadata) + .bin (tile grid). Export from editor->mods/ra/maps/theater-world/. Spawn points: PlaceStartingUnits trait spawns player HQ at each PlayerReference's HomeLocation (set in editor or map.yaml Players section). To create 8-player world-regional map: paint 8 landmasses, place HQ spawn per region. (3) SCALE: Standard RA is 128x128; THEATER world-map recommendation is 192x192 (50% bigger) or 256x256 (full 2x), doable within engine limits. Files: mods/ra/rules/map-generators.yaml (ClassicMapGenerator already exists, no changes needed), mods/ra/maps/theater-world/map.yaml (hand-crafted world map metadata), or procedurally generated via lobby (Players dropdown, select generator). Engine handles spawn placement via MapStartingLocations.cs (stock trait, no custom code).
impl.visualRevampHooks: VISUAL REVAMP HOOKS (RenderVoxels for 32-facing Art Upgrade Path). Engine already ships the plumbing for HD/retro swap. (1) SPRITE RENDERING: RenderSprites.cs (file /Users/ashishnaik/Projects/openra/OpenRA.Mods.Common/Traits/Render/RenderSprites.cs) has Image field (defaults to actor name, e.g., MNLY), and FactionImages dict to override per faction. Engine loads sprites via ISpriteLoader: SHPLoader (RA classic .shp), PngSheetLoader (modern .png with metadata). (2) VOXEL RENDERING: RenderVoxels.cs (file /Users/ashishnaik/Projects/openra/OpenRA.Mods.Cnc/Traits/Render/RenderVoxels.cs) accepts 3D .vxl/.hva models, renders to indexed-color PNG at runtime via orthographic turntable (11.25deg steps, 32 facings). Already proven in TS mod. Pipeline: 3D model -> Blender orthographic turntable (custom script or manual export) -> downscale -> indexed palette remap -> .vxl/.hva or direct PNG frames. (3) SHADER/POST-PROCESSING: Engine shader pipeline (Renderer trait, WorldRenderer.cs, not exposed in mod-data) supports bloom, contact AO, soft shadows. No public mod-data hook yet, but code is in OpenRA.Graphics namespace; custom C# trait can add custom post-effects. (4) PHASE 1 MVP: Use RenderSprites Image + FactionImages, supply PNG cameos only (no retro silhouettes change). PHASE 3: Commission bespoke Blender 32-facings per hero unit, deploy via RenderVoxels (requires new trait on unit: WithVoxelBody inherits from RenderVoxels config). Files: mods/ra/uibits/cameos/*.png (GPT-generated, chroma-keyed, indexed), mods/ra/sequences/*.yaml (frame definitions), OpenRA.Mods.Common/Traits/Render/RenderSprites.cs (production code, FactionImages already there), OpenRA.Mods.Cnc/Traits/Render/RenderVoxels.cs (3D-to-sprite render pipeline, ready to use).
impl.detail: THEATER IMPLEMENTATION BLUEPRINT (Engine-Correct, BUILDABLE). SOLID FOUNDATIONS (Already Built / Verified Engine-Correct): Phase 0b slice (territory economy + develop mechanic) is proven working: DevelopsWhileHeld.cs trait runs in-engine, determinism verified. Theater.yaml + theater-setup.lua (Lua auto-placer, deterministic integer-only math) also in-repo and playtested. Hybrid economy (ore at 100% + territory as bonus, asymmetric structures, no replacement thesis) validated via 11-agent workflow and accepted. NOW BUILD ON IT. Core Implementation Plan: (1) FACTIONS (YAML-only): Add mods/ra/rules/theater-factions.yaml with Faction@federation, Faction@union, ... (12 new blocs) following exact pattern from mods/cnc/rules/world.yaml. Add fluent messages to mods/ra/fluent/rules.ftl (72 strings total: 12 factions x 2 each [Name, Description]). NO C# CHANGES. (2) UNIT ROSTER (YAML + Reskin): Fork existing RA units. Example: MNLY (Mammoth) becomes FED_MNLY (Federation Mammoth). New YAML entry: FED_MNLY Inherits: MNLY, Tooltip Name: actor-fed-mammoth.name, Buildable Prerequisites: federation.hq, RenderSprites Image: mnly, FactionImages: federation: mnly_fed (for Phase 3+ bespoke art). Store in mods/ra/rules/theater-units.yaml. Cameo icons: generate via gpt-image-2 (design/art/generate_image.py), chroma-key via postprocess_cameo.py, save as mods/ra/uibits/cameos/unit_fed_mammoth_128.png. Define sprite/icon sequences in mods/ra/sequences/theater-cameos.yaml. Total Phase 1: ~150-200 sprite sequences (icon camos, no in-world art change). (3) TECH/RESEARCH (Prerequisites chains): Create EraCenter building (actor ERAC) that provides era.one, era.two, etc. as ProvidesPrerequisite traits. Gate units via Prerequisites: era.one, doctrine.military. Add LobbyPrerequisiteCheckbox to World player for each doctrine fork (4 checkboxes). Define in mods/ra/rules/theater-research.yaml. Pure mod-data. (4) TERRITORY (Already built phase 0b): Use theater.yaml's CTRLCASH (develop), CTRLLAB (tech unlock), FCOM (build foothold). Theater-setup.lua auto-places. NO CHANGES. (5) DEV UNLOCK: Enhance World LobbyPrerequisiteCheckbox in mods/ra/rules/player.yaml to include checkbox that grants all 12+ faction + era prerequisites when enabled. NO C# CHANGES. (6) WORLD MAP: Use existing ClassicMapGenerator + hand-paint terrain in editor -> mods/ra/maps/theater-world/map.yaml. Or use Continents setting. NO NEW CODE. (7) VISUAL ROADMAP: Phase 1 MVP uses RA body + modern cameos (GPT). Phase 3+: Blender 3D-turntables, RenderVoxels trait on hero units, deploy as PNG sheets or .vxl (engine supports both). Shaders (bloom/AO) deferred until custom C# trait if desired. HONEST MOD-DATA vs C# SPLIT: MOD-DATA: ~95% (factions, units, tech tree, territory, dev unlock, map). C# ONLY: 0-2 new traits if needed (none required for MVP; all existing traits suffice). Deferred C#: RefineryConcession amplifier (owner-change mutation handling), live diplomacy (player relationship mutation + sync), campaign persistence layer, PvE systems. RISK MITIGATION: Phase 0 already killed the core risk (harvester loop death). Phase 1 (this blueprint) is low-risk: all systems are mod-data reskins of proven traits. Phase 2 (detailed balance, 3 factions, bot tuning) is medium-risk (but sequential, gated). Phase 3 (art pipeline + bespoke sprites) is the schedule-setter (art throughput, not engine). MEASURABLE GATES: After Phase 1 (roster + tech tree + factions): One skirmish map, 6 factions (launch set), all tech/research tree interactive, all units buildable, dev-mode unlocks everything. Playtestable, deterministic, fast. SCHEDULE ESTIMATE: Phase 1 YAML work: 2-3 wks (trait config + fluent strings + unit variants). Phase 2 Balance+bot: 6-10 wks (3 factions, min 3x3 matchup coverage, loss-reason telemetry). Phase 3 Art POC: 2-4 wks (1 hero unit through full Blender->sprite pipeline, measure wall-clock cost, decide scale). Real ship date depends on Phase 3 art discovery. NEXT IMMEDIATE ACTION: Create theater-factions.yaml with 6 launch-set factions (federation, union, continental, levant, anatolian, peninsula). Each: Faction@<name>, ProvidesPrerequisite@hq with Prerequisite: <name>.hq. Add fluent strings. Build 2-3 reskinned units per faction using RA bases (no art cost). Run skirmish: 2-player, each picks a faction, tech tree unlocks doctrines on first build, units appear conditional on faction. Iterate balance.

commonUnits.name: Rifleman
commonUnits.role: Basic anti-infantry line trooper; cheap, mass-able, captures-screen filler. The bread-and-butter you spam from the Barracks turn one.

commonUnits.name: AT Trooper (Javelin Team)
commonUnits.role: Anti-vehicle / anti-structure infantry (the rocket soldier body). Counters the common MBT/IFV; weak in the open to anti-infantry fire and splash.

commonUnits.name: Combat Engineer
commonUnits.role: Captures buildings and the neutral territory nodes, repairs structures/bridges. The single most important common unit for the territory-economy layer (captures CTRLCASH/FCOM/CTRLLAB).

commonUnits.name: Main Battle Tank (M-series 'Abrams-class')
commonUnits.role: Core medium/main battle tank, the army's backbone. Strong vs vehicles and structures, vulnerable to AT infantry, aircraft and artillery.

commonUnits.name: Infantry Fighting Vehicle (IFV)
commonUnits.role: Armored personnel carrier / troop transport with light AT punch. Carries infantry to the front, light raiding, anti-light-vehicle. Soft vs dedicated tanks.

commonUnits.name: Field Howitzer
commonUnits.role: Towed/SP artillery: long-range siege and anti-cluster splash. Wrecks massed infantry and static defenses; helpless up close, fragile, slow.

commonUnits.name: SHORAD AA Vehicle (mobile flak)
commonUnits.role: Mobile short-range air defense (the flak-truck body). The common answer to helicopters, drones and attack jets; also shreds infantry. Light armor.

commonUnits.name: Recon Scout (4x4)
commonUnits.role: Fast wheeled scout / early harasser with a light MG. Reveals the map and the contested nodes, snipes harvesters and stray infantry. Dies to anything heavier.

commonUnits.name: Resource Hauler
commonUnits.role: Harvester-equivalent: hauls the abundant open-field resource (Petroleum/Iron) back to the Refinery. Worth a bounty when killed (GivesBounty) so harvester-hunting is the 'protect' attack vector.

commonUnits.name: Transport Helicopter
commonUnits.role: Air troop transport / rapid insertion (the Chinook body). Drops infantry behind lines, grabs far nodes, evacuates. Unarmed, must be escorted; SHORAD bait.

commonUnits.name: Strike Fighter
commonUnits.role: Common attack jet: fast ground-attack runs vs armor and structures, rearms at the Airfield. The generic air threat every faction can field; countered by AA vehicles and SAM.

commonBuildings.name: Command HQ (Construction Yard)
commonBuildings.role: The base — produces and provides build radius. Modern-named MCV-deployable construction yard; root prerequisite of the whole tree.

commonBuildings.name: Power Plant
commonBuildings.role: Supplies base power; under-power slows production and disables grid-dependent defenses/EW. Advanced variant (apwr) is the higher-output upgrade.

commonBuildings.name: Refinery
commonBuildings.role: Processes the hauled open-field resource into Credits; spawns the first Resource Hauler. Pairs with Storage Silos (silo) for overflow.

commonBuildings.name: Barracks
commonBuildings.role: Trains all common infantry (Rifleman, AT Trooper, Engineer, scouts on foot). First production building most matches.

commonBuildings.name: War Factory
commonBuildings.role: Builds all common ground vehicles (MBT, IFV, artillery, AA, scout, hauler) and faction unique vehicles. The armored-core production hub.

commonBuildings.name: Airfield
commonBuildings.role: Builds and rearms fixed-wing aircraft (Strike Fighter, faction unique jets/UCAVs). Helipad (hpad) is the rotary-wing equivalent for the Transport Helicopter and gunships.

commonBuildings.name: Radar Command (Radar Dome)
commonBuildings.role: Unlocks the minimap/radar and is the mid-tier tech prerequisite. Locational sensor coverage; a fragile high-value EW target.

commonBuildings.name: Tech Center
commonBuildings.role: Top-tier tech prerequisite gating late-game units, superweapons and era-up doctrine unlocks (the ATEK/STEK role).

commonBuildings.name: Service Depot
commonBuildings.role: Repairs vehicles; forward-built it changes every tank trade nearby (the capability the Rhine Compact leans on).

commonBuildings.name: Gun Turret
commonBuildings.role: Cheap base anti-vehicle turret — the entry-tier static defense (the GUN/FTUR role).

commonBuildings.name: SAM Site
commonBuildings.role: Static anti-air site; the band-locked dedicated air defense building. AGUN (agun) is the gun-based AA alternative for low/cheap threats.

commonBuildings.name: Pillbox
commonBuildings.role: Cheap static anti-infantry emplacement for holding chokes and ore routes; the positional-fortification entry piece.

factions.detail:
CONTENT BLUEPRINT — THEATER first complete playable build (8 factions + shared common set). All RA actor IDs verified against mods/ra/rules/{infantry,vehicles,aircraft,structures}.yaml.

ENGINE-CORRECTNESS NOTES (verified against repo, for the orchestrator building this next):

1. HOW FACTIONS WORK IN OPENRA. Factions are NOT separate rule files — they are entries in mods/ra/rules/world.yaml under the World actor's `Faction:` traits, each with Name/InternalName/Side/Selectable. Per-faction unit access is data-driven via the `Buildable:` trait's `Prerequisites:` using the pseudo-prerequisite `faction-<internalname>` (e.g. Prerequisites: techcenter, ~techlevel.high, federation). The engine resolves `~<name>` / `!<name>` prerequisite tokens including faction tokens; see ProvidesPrerequisite + Buildable.Prerequisites. So each unique unit/building is the SAME actor pool gated by a faction prerequisite — no engine changes needed for the roster itself.

2. SHARED COMMON SET = the spine. Every faction can build all commonUnits/commonBuildings; the faction prerequisite only gates the 1-2 unique units + 1 unique building. This matches the design's 'asymmetry by strategic use, not stat tiers' pillar (contemporary-openra-design.md §5) and OpenRA's proven sub-faction template.

3. UNIQUE-UNIT IMPLEMENTATION PATTERN. Each unique unit is a NEW actor that Inherits the chosen RA body actor (e.g. SPECTER: Inherits: MIG) then overrides RenderSprites.Image to reuse the existing art, sets a modern Tooltip Name, a new Buildable.Prerequisites including the faction token + appropriate tech building, and the role-defining trait tweaks (Cloak for Specter, GrantConditionOnDeploy/ProximityExternalCondition auras for C2 vehicles, JamsMissiles/AttackAircraft for Aegis, etc.). This is exactly the pattern already proven in theater.yaml (CTRLCASH Inherits OILB, CTRLLAB Inherits BIO with RenderSprites.Image override). For the FIRST build, art ceiling = reuse the mapped RA body sprite; only the cameo is new (gpt-image-2, flat-magenta pipeline per design/art/).

4. AURA / DEBUFF UNIQUES are engine-real but need the right trait: army-wide targeting buff (Federation Joint Command Network) = player-scoped GrantConditionOnPrerequisite + a FirepowerMultiplier/RangeMultiplier conditional on nearby units, OR ProximityExternalCondition from the building/C2 vehicle. EW jam (Northern Union Bastion, Anatolian Koral) = a ProximityExternalCondition granting a debuff condition that other units gate accuracy/range on. These exist as traits but each needs a small conditional-multiplier wiring pass; flag as 'needs a wiring pass, not new C#' where a stock conditional multiplier covers it, 'needs new C# trait' only for genuinely novel effects (e.g. reveal-on-enemy-superpower for the Isles Maritime Ops Centre — closest stock is none; would need a small INotify hook on SupportPowerManager).

5. AA / DEFENSE band mapping (design §4.4 three-tier ladder) maps cleanly to stock actors: cheap gun-SHORAD = AGUN / FTRK; C-RAM/Iron-Dome (finite magazine, chance-to-intercept) = needs the Levant 'Aril' APS + Interception Dome behavior, closest stock is the chrono/Iron-Curtain-style; theater SAM = SAM (with a minimum-range dead zone via Armament MinRange). The Continental Integrated Defense Grid and Subcontinent Layered Air-Defense Command both reuse SAM as the body with a coverage/intercept buff aura.

6. DEV MODE (user's explicit ask). Already partly present: theater.yaml sets Player.DeveloperMode.CheckboxEnabled: True and the lua exposes /visibility. To 'unlock EVERYTHING' toggleably: add a lobby checkbox 'Dev: Unlock All' that, when on, grants a global prerequisite token (e.g. 'dev.unlockall') and add that token as an alternative in every Buildable.Prerequisites via `~dev.unlockall` so all factions' units + all tech ignore faction/tech gating. Implement as a GrantConditionOnPrerequisite/ProvidesPrerequisite on a world actor toggled by the DeveloperMode checkbox — no new C# required, pure prerequisite plumbing. This is the cleanest engine-correct route and matches how DeveloperMode already gates cheats.

7. BIG-WORLD TEST MAP. The continents/regions map with many country spawns is a MAP asset (a large RA map with N spawn points, each spawn assignable to a faction in lobby) plus the theater-setup.lua node auto-placer (already exists) extended to scatter the territory nodes across regions. No engine change; it is a map + lua deliverable. Spawn count should >= 8 to seat all launch factions; design toward ~12+ for the full real-world feel.

PRIORITY FOR FIRST PLAYABLE BUILD (art-ceiling honest): ship all 8 factions reusing RA bodies + new cameos only. Bespoke Blender 32-facing art is deserved (and listed in designNotes) for the silhouette-defining uniques — Specter, Lowe heavy MBT, Amatsu Aegis, Kunai robot, Bayrak/Wing Loong drones — but is PHASE-2; the first build proves faction identity through stats/auras/cameos, not new bodies.

The 8 launch factions span the design space deliberately: Federation (air/info tempo), Northern Union (armor/artillery attrition), Continental Bloc (A2AD/denial/drones), Rhine Compact (durability/positional), Isles Coalition (intel/raiding/stealth), Eastern Maritime Pact (defensive robotics/Aegis), Subcontinent Federation (shielded long-range + numbers), Anatolian Alliance (cheap drone swarm + EW). Distinct counters interlock: Continental/Subcontinent A2AD hard-counters Federation/Anatolian air; Anatolian Koral EW and Northern Union Bastion jam the A2AD networks back open; Eastern Maritime Aegis swats Subcontinent/Northern Union missiles; Isles intel pre-empts everyone's support powers; Rhine durability grinds where it stands but is bypassed by tempo. No faction is stat-superior — each strength is the seam (per §5 balancing rules).
factions.designNotes:
BESPOKE BLENDER 32-FACING ART (Phase-2, ranked by identity-payoff per design §7 pipeline A): 1) Specter stealth fighter (Federation) — silhouette is the brand; 2) Lowe heavy MBT (Rhine) — durability must read as visibly heavier than the common 2tnk; 3) Bayrak + Wing Loong drones (Anatolian/Continental) — drone forms read poorly reusing yak/mig; 4) Amatsu Aegis platform (Eastern Maritime) — the flat phased-array panel is iconic; 5) Kunai combat robot (Eastern Maritime) — robotic body unlike any RA infantry; 6) Garuda/Vanguard/Smerch launchers — the v2rl body is reused 4x across factions so 2-3 distinct launcher bodies de-duplicate the silhouette clash. EVERYTHING ELSE reuses RA bodies for the first build.

CAMEO BATCH: all 12 unique-unit cameos + 8 unique-building cameos generate via design/art/generate_image.py (gpt-image-2, flat magenta) then design/art/postprocess_cameo.py (chroma-key + crop + downscale to 128). Prompts above are written to that pipeline's spec.

V2RL REUSE COLLISION: Smerch (Northern), Vanguard (Continental), Garuda (Subcontinent) all map to v2rl. For the first build differentiate by team-color + stats + cameo; for Phase-2 give each a distinct launcher body (saturation rockets vs A2AD missiles vs single cruise missile) — this is the single highest-value de-duplication in the roster.

WIRING-PASS vs NEW-C# LEDGER (so the orchestrator scopes correctly): pure data/prereq (no code) = the whole faction roster, dev-mode unlock-all, the big-world map. Conditional-multiplier WIRING PASS (stock traits, just YAML conditions) = Federation targeting aura, Bastion/Koral EW jam debuff, Lowe self-repair-while-stationary (SelfHealing + RequiresCondition on a !moving condition), Eastern Maritime free-robot pad (existing reinforcement/ProduceActor support power), Continental/Subcontinent AA coverage buffs, SAM minimum-range dead zone (Armament.MinRange). GENUINELY NEW C# (defer or simplify) = Isles 'reveal enemy support-power launch' (no stock hook on SupportPowerManager — the same constraint theater.yaml line 14-16 already documented), and Levant-style APS 'intercept first incoming missile' (no stock per-projectile interception trait). The first build can SHIP the Isles/Eastern uniques with simplified stock-only effects (Isles = wide stealth-detection radar dome; APS deferred to a later faction wave) and still hit 8 distinct playstyles.

NAMING/SENSITIVITY (per design §5 stance): fictional callsigns, factions framed as defensive doctrines, no real insignia/leaders — the cameo prompts use muted/derived marks (star-and-bar, crescent, sun, tricolour chevron) not real flags. Ship the abstract-name toggle later for sensitive markets.

NEXT ACTIONS FOR ORCHESTRATOR: (1) write mods/ra/rules/theater-factions.yaml with the 8 Faction world-traits + the ~20 new unique actors (Inherits + RenderSprites.Image + Tooltip + Buildable.Prerequisites:faction-token); (2) add common-set modern Tooltip names as an overlay ruleset (don't rename stock actors — overlay Tooltip.Name so cnc/ra stay intact); (3) batch-generate the 20 cameos; (4) wire the conditional-multiplier auras (the WIRING-PASS list); (5) build the big-world map + extend theater-setup.lua node placement; (6) add the dev-mode unlock-all prerequisite toggle. Validate each ruleset with ./utility.sh ra --check-yaml before committing (per CLAUDE.md).

blenderUnits.name: Specter Stealth Fighter (Federation unique)
blenderUnits.description: Highest identity-payoff: the brand silhouette. Model a sleek single-seat angular stealth strike jet — faceted radar-absorbent flat panels (no smooth curves), blended wing-body, twin canted tail fins, sharp chined nose, internal weapons bay (closed), small canards. Matte grey-charcoal multi-tone paneling with subtle panel-line detail and a faint emissive blue glow strip along the canards/intakes for the sensor motif. Scale to read as a fast strike jet over the common Strike Fighter. Build for a top-down 32-facing turntable: model fully closed-form, origin at center of mass, nose pointing toward +X (OpenRA facing 0 = east convention), bake a flat low-vis matte material with a separate team-color mask channel on the tail/roundel area. Render orthographic-ish top-down at the engine's standard pitch for the 32 rotation steps.

blenderUnits.name: Lowe Heavy MBT (Rhine Compact unique)
blenderUnits.description: Must read as visibly heavier and bulkier than the common Main Battle Tank (2tnk) at a glance. Model a hulking heavy MBT: thick wedge-shaped composite turret cheeks, a long large-caliber smoothbore gun, pronounced slat/cage side armor and skirts, wide tracks, a low aggressive stance, commander cupola and stowage bins for visual mass. Gunmetal-grey with a muted Rhine iron-cross-derived chevron decal on the turret side (team-color masked). Emphasize armor thickness in silhouette so it differs from the standard tank even at sprite scale. Build for 32-facing turntable: separate turret object so it can rotate independently if the engine sequence uses turret/barrel sub-sprites; origin at hull center, barrel pointing +X, team-color mask on hull flanks and chevron.

blenderUnits.name: Bayrak / Wing Loong Combat Drone (shared body for Anatolian + Continental uniques)
blenderUnits.description: Drone forms read poorly when reusing the yak/mig bodies, so build ONE shared slender prop-driven UCAV body usable for both the Bayrak UCAV (inverted-V tail) and the Wing Loong swarm drone (conventional tail) — model with a swappable tail-group object. Smooth pale composite fuselage, bulbous electro-optical sensor ball under the nose, long straight high-aspect wings with two small underwing munitions, single nose or pusher prop. Keep it small/light in silhouette to signal 'cheap and attritable'. Build for 32-facing turntable: nose toward +X, origin at fuselage centroid, flat matte composite material with a small team-color mask on the tail; deliver two tail variants (inverted-V and straight) sharing the same fuselage UV.

blenderUnits.description: The flat phased-array panel is iconic and must dominate the silhouette. Model a heavy tracked air-defense vehicle: a boxy armored superstructure carrying ONE large flat octagonal phased-array radar panel canted upward on each forward face, a bank of flush vertical-launch missile cells on the rear deck, a wide tracked chassis. Pearl-grey and navy paneling with a muted red sun mark and faint emissive cyan glow on the array faces. Make the angular flat radar panel the dominant readable feature from top-down. Build for 32-facing turntable: hull origin centered, front (array face) toward +X, team-color mask on the hull skirts and sun mark, emissive channel on the array.

blenderUnits.description: A robotic body unlike any RA infantry, so it needs bespoke art to not look like a reskinned soldier. Model a compact armored autonomous combat robot: a hunched quadruped-plus-torso chassis (digitigrade rear legs, a low armored torso, a stubby autocannon arm and a sensor-cluster head). Matte white-and-grey segmented plating with cyan optic glow and a small Eastern Maritime sun mark. Keep the silhouette clearly non-human and readable at infantry sprite scale. Build for 32-facing turntable AND a small walk/idle pose set if the infantry sequence needs frames: facing +X at rest, origin at ground-contact center, team-color mask on the torso plating, emissive cyan on the optic.

blenderUnits.name: Saturation / A2AD / Cruise Launcher trio (de-duplicates the v2rl body, shared across 3 factions)
blenderUnits.description: The v2rl launcher body is reused FOUR times across the roster (Smerch, Vanguard, Garuda) which makes the silhouettes clash; this is the single highest-value de-duplication. Model THREE distinct wheeled/tracked launcher bodies sharing a common 8-wheel truck cab base: (a) SATURATION — a dense bank of many medium rocket tubes in an elevated box (Smerch); (b) A2AD — a few long upward-canted large interceptor missiles on a tracked TEL with a small radar panel (Vanguard); (c) CRUISE — a single large sleek cruise missile in a canted launch canister (Garuda). Distinct enough to tell apart at sprite scale. Build each for a 32-facing turntable: cab nose toward +X, origin at chassis center, launcher group as a separate object so the elevated/erected pose can be a state, team-color mask on the cab doors and chassis.

artjobs.detail:
ART DIRECTION — THEATER first-build GPT-image job list, written to the proven design/art/ pipeline (generate_image.py renders gpt-image-2 at 1024x1024 on flat magenta; postprocess_cameo.py chroma-keys #FF00FF, autocrops, downscales to 128). All cameo prompts therefore explicitly request a FLAT MAGENTA #FF00FF background and 128-centered composition; emblems/UI request larger canvases (emblems 512, UI 16:9/4:3 — pass --size to the generator).

COVERAGE: 8 emblems (one per faction). 45 cameos = 11 common units + 12 common buildings + 12 unique units + 8 unique buildings + the 2 extra common-set bodies the roster implies (Helipad/Advanced Power are covered by reusing Airfield/Power Plant cameos, so not double-generated). The 12 unique-unit and 8 unique-building cameo prompts are carried verbatim from the roster JSON's per-actor cameoPrompt fields (they were already authored to this spec) so the orchestrator can batch them as-is; the common-set cameos are newly authored here in the identical style. 3 UI pieces (main loading splash, faction-select war-room background, codex hero plate).

ART-CEILING HONESTY (matches the content blueprint): for the FIRST playable build, only NEW art needed is these cameos + emblems + UI — every in-world unit/building BODY reuses its mapped RA sprite (Specter=mig, Lowe=3tnk, etc.). The 6 blenderUnits are PHASE-2 bespoke 32-facing turntable bodies, ranked by identity payoff per design designNotes: (1) Specter — silhouette is the brand; (2) Lowe — durability must read heavier than common 2tnk; (3) Bayrak/Wing Loong shared drone body — drones read poorly on yak/mig; (4) Amatsu Aegis — flat phased-array is iconic; (5) Kunai robot — non-human body; (6) the v2rl launcher trio — single highest-value de-dup since v2rl is reused 4x. Each blender description specifies +X = facing-0/east, centered origin, a separate team-color mask channel, and separable turret/launcher/tail sub-objects for the 32-facing turntable, consistent with design §7 pipeline A.

STYLE LOCK (every cameo shares this so the sidebar reads cohesively): 'retro-but-revamped' clean HD-pixel diorama, bold silhouette-first forms, 3/4 top-down hero angle, soft top-down studio light + restrained rim light, subtle dithered shading, crisp edges, NO text, NO scenery, flat magenta for keying, 128 centered. Common units/buildings are rendered in NEUTRAL GREY so the engine's team-color overlay applies cleanly; faction uniques keep their muted derived marks (star-and-bar, red star, gold star, Rhine chevron, Isles ensign, sun, tricolour chevron, crescent) per the design's sensitivity stance — no real flags or insignia, no leaders.

ORCHESTRATOR RUN NOTES: generate cameos with `python3 design/art/generate_image.py --out raw/<file> --prompt \"<prompt>\" --background opaque` (gpt-image-2 has no transparent bg — request opaque/flat magenta), then `python3 design/art/postprocess_cameo.py --in raw/<file> --out mods/ra/bits/theater/cameos/<file> --size 128`. Emblems: same flow at --size 256 or 512 (the postprocess --size flag controls final). UI pieces: generate at --size 1536x1024 (loading + faction-select) and 1280x1024 (codex), skip the cameo chroma-key/crop (they keep their painted backgrounds). Wire cameos into actors via the RenderSprites/Tooltip + Buildable Icon (the standard OpenRA cameo hookup in chrome/sequences) once the theater-factions.yaml actors exist."

masterplan.northStar: "Done enough to iterate from" = ONE big-world skirmish map you can launch via ./theater-play.sh where: (a) all 8 launch factions appear in the lobby and are pickable per-player; (b) every faction can build the full SHARED common roster (11 units + 13 buildings) under modern names with new cameos; (c) each faction's 1-2 unique units + 1 unique building are buildable, gated by a faction-token prerequisite, visually distinct via cameo + team color (RA bodies reused); (d) a 4-tier era/research chain and 4 lobby doctrine checkboxes actually gate units; (e) a "Dev: Unlock All" lobby checkbox + DeveloperMode cheats unlock every faction's units + all tech; (f) the territory-economy layer (CTRLCASH/FCOM/CTRLLAB, already built) auto-places across the map. It compiles, passes ./utility.sh ra --check-yaml, runs deterministically, and is FUN to play in a 2-8 player skirmish. This is a first-complete-vertical: faction IDENTITY reads through stats/auras/cameos/names, NOT new in-world bodies. Bespoke Blender hero art, live diplomacy, APS interception, reveal-on-enemy-superpower, and shader post-processing are explicitly deferred. The bar is "a friend can pick Turkey vs the USA on a world map, swarm drones into a targeting-net deathball, and have it feel like a different game than stock RA" — not "shipped, balanced, art-complete."

masterplan.honestScope: This is a LARGE build delivered as a first-complete-vertical, not a finished, balanced, art-complete game — and that distinction is load-bearing. What M1-M3 buy you (the 'iterate-from-here' core) is genuinely buildable almost entirely in mod-data with ZERO new C#, because the prior Phase-0 work already killed the one real engine risk (the harvester-loop-death thesis) and verified the trait pattern (CTRLCASH Inherits OILB, DevelopsWhileHeld on disk). The 8-faction roster, eras, doctrines, dev-unlock, and the world map are all prerequisite-token reskins of proven stock traits — low risk, fast to author (~2-4 weeks of YAML/fluent/Lua + the parallel cameo batch). The honest seams: (1) FACTION IDENTITY IN THE FIRST BUILD reads through cameo + name + stats + auras, NOT new in-world bodies — every unit is still an RA silhouette until M4's Blender batch, and the v2rl body is reused 4x (Smerch/Vanguard/Garuda/Koral-adjacent) which WILL look samey until de-duplicated. (2) THE AURAS ARE A WIRING PASS, not a guarantee — ProximityExternalCondition/conditional-multiplier auras are stock, but each needs hands-on tuning to feel like a force-multiplier rather than a number; budget iteration there. (3) TWO EFFECTS ARE GENUINELY NEW C# AND DEFERRED: Isles 'reveal enemy support-power launch' (no stock SupportPowerManager hook — ships as a plain wide stealth-detection dome) and Levant-style APS per-projectile interception (no stock trait — cut from the launch 8 entirely). (4) LIVE DIPLOMACY IS DESCOPED: lockstep makes mid-match player-relationship mutation a real desync risk, so MVP diplomacy = static lobby Allies/Enemies + optional Lua-scripted neutral minors; pacts/decay/betrayal are a later C# wave. (5) M4 IS ART-THROUGHPUT-BOUND, not engine-bound — the schedule's real unknown is wall-clock cost per Blender hero unit, which is why M4 starts with ONE hero through the full pipeline to measure before committing to all six. (6) SHADER POST-PROCESSING (de-blur/bloom/AO) has no mod-data hook and is OPTIONAL/last. Net: you can reach a fun, deterministic, 8-faction world-map skirmish with dev-mode-unlock-all on pure mod-data + a cameo batch; 'shipped and polished' is M5+ and gated on art and a small amount of UI/diplomacy C#.
